definitions.complete: Confidently resolved to a canonical medicine with source-backed evidence. This describes identity extraction, not a claim that every sentence in the source was captured.
definitions.doubtful: Ambiguous or low-confidence source text, including mappings accepted only through fuzzy OCR; medical review is recommended.
definitions.not_understood: Medicine-like source text could not be mapped safely to a canonical medicine.
definitions.excluded: OCR noise or text classified as non-remedy; retained for audit only.
